text: Jesse Byock, professor at the University of California, Los Angeles, is the director of the Mosfell Archaeological Project and Phillip Walker, professor at the University of California, Santa Barbara, is the co-director. Major members of the team are Prof. Jon Erlandson University of Oregon, Prof. Per Holck University of Oslo, Magnús Guðmundsson University of Iceland, Davide Zori University of California. The Mosfell Archaeological Project works closely with archaeologists and conservators at the National Museum of Iceland, scholars from the University of Iceland, representatives from the town of Mosfellsbær, and local historians and inhabitants of the Mosfell Valley.
